name: app-oviah-survey-and-interview-findings-stat-grid
title: OVIAH primary research slide: a lilac stat grid of survey percentages beside real interview quotes
whatItIs: A slide titled 'Survey Data & Interview Findings' with a tinted-block grid: sample details (82 survey responses, 7 interviews), large bold percentages (85% face cramps, 67% ask friends/family, 58% track periods, 46.4% have PCOS/PCOD-type symptoms, 68% lost an old medical report), and a photo tile with three quoted pain points.
whatItMeans: Evidence-backed and human; big stats paired with verbatim quotes make the research feel both rigorous and real.
techniques: Vary tile size to emphasise the most important stats.
Include a sample-size note for credibility.
End a stat grid with direct user quotes, not just numbers.

vocabulary.definition: The number of respondents a survey is based on.
A user's exact words used as evidence.
